intro.en: A reading passage about taking healthy breaks. Islam allows lawful fun, as the Prophet ﷺ joked but said only the truth. The passage also says fun must not become mockery or waste of time.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek parhne ka matn hai jo jaiz tafreeh ke baare mein hai. Islam jaiz khel aur dil-lagi ki ijazat deta hai; Nabi ﷺ mazaq karte the lekin sirf sach kehte the. Magar tafreeh waqt ki barbadi ya kisi ka mazaq udaane ka zariya na bane.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ الِاسْتِراحَةِ المُفيدَةِ: يُجيزُ الإِسْلامُ اللَّهْوَ المُباحَ، فَقَدْ كانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَمْزَحُ وَلا يَقولُ إِلّا حَقّاً. وَيُبَيِّنُ النَّصُّ أَنَّ التَّرْويحَ لا يَصيرُ سُخْرِيَةً وَلا إِضاعَةً لِلْوَقْتِ.

dialogue.ar: النَّفْسُ الإِنْسانِيَّةُ تَمَلُّ مِنَ الجِدِّ وَالعَمَل.
dialogue.tr: an-nafsu l-insāniyyatu tamallu mina l-jiddi wal-ʿamal
dialogue.en: The human soul gets tired of seriousness and work.
dialogue.ur: Insaani nafs mehnat aur kaam se thak jaati hai.

dialogue.ar: لِهذا تُجيزُ تَعاليمُ الإِسْلامِ لِلإِنْسانِ أَنْ يُرَوِّحَ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ بِاللَّهْوِ المُباح.
dialogue.tr: li-hādhā tujīzu taʿālīmu l-islāmi li-l-insāni an yuraw-wiḥa ʿan nafsihi bi-l-lahwi l-mubāḥ
dialogue.en: So Islam's teachings allow a person to relax with lawful fun.
dialogue.ur: Isi liye Islam ki taleemaat insaan ko jaiz tafreeh se apne aap ko behlane ki ijazat deti hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلَنا في رَسولِ اللهِ ﷺ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَة؛ فَقَدْ كانَ يَضْحَكُ وَيَمْزَحُ بِالقَوْلِ الصّادِق.
dialogue.tr: wa lanā fī rasūli llāh uswatun ḥasana; faqad kāna yaḍḥaku wa yamzaḥu bi-l-qawli ṣ-ṣādiq
dialogue.en: We have a good example in the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: he laughed and joked, saying only the truth.
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ mein hamare liye behtareen namoona hai: woh hanste aur mazaq karte the, magar sirf sach kehte the.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ لَهُمْ ﷺ: «إِنّي لا أَقولُ إِلّا حَقّاً».
dialogue.tr: faqāla lahum: innī lā aqūlu illā ḥaqqā
dialogue.en: He said to them: "I say nothing but the truth."
dialogue.ur: Aap ﷺ ne unse farmaya: "Main sirf haq baat kehta hoon."

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ الصَّحابَةُ يَتَمازَحونَ فيما بَيْنَهُمْ وَيُرَوِّحونَ عَنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ بِبَعْضِ الأَنْشِطَةِ المُباحَة.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna ṣ-ṣaḥābatu yatamāzaḥūna fīmā baynahum wa yuraw-wiḥūna ʿan anfusihim bi-baʿḍi l-anshiṭati l-mubāḥa
dialogue.en: The Companions joked with each other and relaxed with some lawful activities.
dialogue.ur: Sahaba aapas mein hansi mazaq karte aur kuch jaiz sargarmiyon se dil behlate the.

dialogue.ar: وَأَجازَ الإِسْلامُ مِنَ الأَنْشِطَةِ التَّرْويحِيَّةِ ما يَتَّفِقُ مَعَ قِيَمِهِ وَآدابِهِ وَأَخْلاقِه.
dialogue.tr: wa ajāza l-islāmu mina l-anshiṭati t-tarwīḥiyyati mā yattafiqu maʿa qiyamihi wa ādābihi wa akhlāqih
dialogue.en: Islam allowed those fun activities that agree with its values, manners and morals.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne wohi tafreehi sargarmiyan jaiz kin jo uski aqdar, adaab aur akhlaq ke mutabiq hon.

dialogue.ar: وَلَيْسَ مَعْنى إِباحَةِ التَّرْويحِ أَنْ تُصْبِحَ الحَياةُ كُلُّها هَزْلاً.
dialogue.tr: wa laysa maʿnā ibāḥati t-tarwīḥi an tuṣbiḥa l-ḥayātu kulluhā hazlā
dialogue.en: Allowing relaxation does not mean that all of life becomes play.
dialogue.ur: Tafreeh ke jaiz hone ka matlab yeh nahi ke saari zindagi khel tamasha ban jaye.

dialogue.ar: فَالحَياةُ أَغْلى مِنْ أَنْ تَضيعَ في لَهْوٍ عابِث.
dialogue.tr: fa-l-ḥayātu aghlā min an taḍīʿa fī lahwin ʿābith
dialogue.en: Life is too precious to be wasted in pointless amusement.
dialogue.ur: Zindagi is se qeemti hai ke bekaar tafreeh mein zaya ho.

dialogue.ar: لِذلِكَ يَجِبُ أَلّا يَأْخُذَ التَّرْويحُ إِلّا قَليلاً مِنَ الوَقْتِ وَالجُهْد.
dialogue.tr: li-dhālika yajibu allā ya'khudha t-tarwīḥu illā qalīlan mina l-waqti wal-juhd
dialogue.en: So relaxation should take only a little time and effort.
dialogue.ur: Isliye tafreeh ko sirf thoda sa waqt aur mehnat lena chahiye.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقولُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبي طالِب: «إِنَّ القُلوبَ تَمَلُّ كَما تَمَلُّ الأَبْدانُ، فَابْتَغوا لَها طَرائِفَ الحِكْمَة».
dialogue.tr: wa yaqūlu ʿAliyyu bnu Abī Ṭālib: inna l-qulūba tamallu kamā tamallu l-abdān, fa-btaghū lahā ṭarā'ifa l-ḥikma
dialogue.en: Ali ibn Abi Talib said: "Hearts get bored as bodies do, so look for wise and witty things for them."
dialogue.ur: Ali bin Abi Talib ne kaha: "Dil bhi thakte hain jaise jism thakte hain, isliye unke liye hikmat bhari dilchasp baatein talash karo."

q.en: According to the passage, what did the Prophet ﷺ say when he joked?
q.ur: Mazaq karte waqt Nabi ﷺ ne kya farmaya?
q.ar: بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ، ماذا قالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ حينَ مَزَحَ؟

q.en: Why should relaxation take only a little time?
q.ur: Tafreeh thodi der kyun honi chahiye?
q.ar: لِماذا يَنْبَغي أَنْ يَكونَ التَّرْويحُ قَليلَ الوَقْتِ؟

options: Because life is too precious to waste / Kyunke zindagi zaya karne se qeemti hai
Because work is forbidden / Kyunke kaam mana hai
Because fun is forbidden / Kyunke tafreeh haraam hai
Because the soul never tires / Kyunke nafs kabhi nahi thakti
options_ar: لِأَنَّ الحَياةَ أَثْمَنُ مِنْ أَنْ تُضَيَّعَ

q.en: What is the plural of «بَدَن» (body) in the exercise?

title.en: Grammar: Nouns of time and place

intro.en: An ism zamān or ism makān names the time or place of an action. From a three-letter verb it comes on the pattern مَفْعِل or مَفْعَل: مَطْلِع (place/time of rising), مَهْبِط (place of descent), مَوْلِد (birthplace/time). Also مَفْعَلَة: مَدْرَسَة, مَكْتَبَة, مَقْبَرَة. Beyond three letters it looks like the passive participle: مُجْتَمَع, مُلْتَقى, مُسْتَوْدَع.
intro.ur: Ism-e-zamaan waqt aur ism-e-makaan jagah batata hai. Teen harfi fe'l se yeh wazan مَفْعِل ya مَفْعَل par aata hai, jaise مَطْلِع (nikalne ki jagah/waqt), مَهْبِط (utarne ki jagah), مَوْلِد (paida hone ki jagah/waqt). Aur مَفْعَلَة jaise مَدْرَسَة, مَكْتَبَة, مَقْبَرَة. Teen se zyada harfon wale fe'l se yeh ism-e-maf'ool jaisa banta hai: مُجْتَمَع, مُلْتَقى, مُسْتَوْدَع.
intro.ar: اسْما الزَّمانِ وَالمَكانِ يَدُلّانِ عَلى وَقْتِ الفِعْلِ أَوْ مَكانِهِ. يُصاغانِ مِنَ الفِعْلِ الثُّلاثِيِّ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفْعِل أَوْ مَفْعَل مِثْلَ مَطْلِع وَمَهْبِط وَمَوْلِد، وَعَلى مَفْعَلَة مِثْلَ مَدْرَسَة وَمَكْتَبَة وَمَقْبَرَة. وَمِنْ غَيْرِ الثُّلاثِيِّ يَأْتِيانِ عَلى صورَةِ اسْمِ المَفْعولِ مِثْلَ مُجْتَمَع وَمُلْتَقى.

vocab.ur: paida hone ki jagah ya waqt

q.en: Which word is a noun of place on the pattern مَفْعَلَة?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz مَفْعَلَة wazan par ism-e-makaan hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ مَكانٍ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفْعَلَة؟

options: Birthplace/time of the Messenger / Rasool ki paidaish ki jagah ya waqt
Death of the Messenger / Rasool ki wafat
Home of the Messenger / Rasool ka ghar
School of the Messenger / Rasool ka school
Place/time of sunrise / Suraj nikalne ki jagah ya waqt

q.en: Which is a noun of place from a verb with more than three letters?
q.ur: Teen se zyada harfon wale fe'l se ism-e-makaan kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ مَكانٍ مِنْ فِعْلٍ يَزيدُ عَلى ثَلاثَةِ أَحْرُفٍ؟

intro.en: Practice spotting time and place nouns in sentences and in Quranic phrases, and give their pattern. Example: مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ (place of sunset) is a noun of place on the pattern مَفْعِل; مَطْلَعِ الفَجْرِ (time of dawn) is a noun of time on the pattern مَفْعَل.
intro.ur: Jumlon aur Quran ke alfaz mein ism-e-zamaan aur ism-e-makaan pehchanne ki mashq. Misaal: مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ (suraj ke doobne ki jagah) ism-e-makaan hai, wazan مَفْعِل; مَطْلَعِ الفَجْرِ (fajr ka waqt) ism-e-zamaan hai, wazan مَفْعَل.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى اسْتِخْراجِ اسْمَيِ الزَّمانِ وَالمَكانِ مِنَ الجُمَلِ وَالعِباراتِ القُرْآنِيَّةِ وَتَحْديدِ وَزْنِهِما. مِثالٌ: «مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ» اسْمُ مَكانٍ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفْعِل، وَ«مَطْلَعِ الفَجْرِ» اسْمُ زَمانٍ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفْعَل.

q.ur: «مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ» kis qism ka ism hai?
«مَطْلَعِ الفَجْرِ» kis qism ka ism hai?

options: Meeting place of the people / Logon ke milne ki jagah
Leader of the people / Qaum ka sardar
Home of the people / Qaum ka ghar
Food of the people / Qaum ka khana

intro.en: This lesson gives an example of a dialogue from the Quran: the story of two men and the garden, from Surat al-Kahf (verses 32 to 44), where a believer and a boastful friend talk to each other. It shows how a dialogue is built: each speaker answers the other.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Quran se guftagu ki misaal hai: do aadmiyon aur baagh ka qissa, Surah al-Kahf (aayat 32 se 44), jis mein ek momin aur ghamand karne wala saathi baat karte hain. Isse pata chalta hai ke guftagu mein har bolne wala doosre ko jawab deta hai.
intro.ar: يَعْرِضُ هٰذا الدَّرْسُ نَموذَجاً لِلْحِوارِ في القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ: قِصَّةُ صاحِبِ الجَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ سورَةِ الكَهْفِ (الآياتُ ٣٢ إِلى ٤٤) حَيْثُ يَتَحاوَرُ مُؤْمِنٌ وَصاحِبٌ مُتَكَبِّرٌ. وَيُبَيِّنُ كَيْفَ يُبْنى الحِوارُ: يَرُدُّ كُلُّ مُتَكَلِّمٍ عَلى الآخَرِ.

options: He talks with him / Woh us se guftagu karta hai
He runs from him / Woh us se bhaagta hai
He helps him / Woh uski madad karta hai
He teaches him / Woh use sikhata hai

q.en: What did Allah make for one of the two men?
q.ur: Allah ne un do aadmiyon mein se ek ke liye kya banaya?

q.en: A conversation between two people is called:
q.ur: Do logon ki baat cheet ko kehte hain:
q.ar: ما اسْمُ الحَديثِ المُتَبادَلِ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ؟

intro.en: Ism at-tafdīl compares two things, on the pattern أَفْعَل: مُحَمَّدٌ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ عَلِيّ (Muhammad is older than Ali). Use مِنْ before the thing compared. With «ال» it becomes the superlative: الأَكْبَر (the oldest), and it agrees with the noun in number and gender (الكُبْرى for a woman). خَيْر and شَرّ also work as comparatives.
intro.ur: Ism-e-tafdeel do cheezon ka muqabla karta hai, wazan أَفْعَل: مُحَمَّدٌ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ عَلِيّ (Muhammad Ali se bada hai). Jis se muqabla ho us se pehle مِنْ aata hai. «ال» ke saath yeh sab se zyada ka matlab deta hai: الأَكْبَر (sab se bada) aur noun ke mutabiq muzakkar/muannas aur wahid/jam' badalta hai (aurat ke liye الكُبْرى). خَيْر aur شَرّ bhi tafdeel ke tor par aate hain.
intro.ar: اسْمُ التَّفْضيلِ يُقارِنُ بَيْنَ شَيْئَيْنِ وَهُوَ عَلى وَزْنِ أَفْعَل: مُحَمَّدٌ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ عَلِيّ. وَنَأْتي بِـ«مِنْ» قَبْلَ المُفَضَّلِ عَلَيْهِ. وَإِذا دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ «ال» صارَ لِلتَّفْضيلِ المُطْلَقِ مِثْلَ الأَكْبَر، وَيُطابِقُ المَوْصوفَ في العَدَدِ وَالنَّوْعِ (الكُبْرى لِلْمُؤَنَّثِ). وَكَلِمَتا خَيْر وَشَرّ تُسْتَعْمَلانِ لِلتَّفْضيلِ أَيْضاً.

dialogue.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ عَلِيٍّ.
dialogue.tr: Muḥammadun akbaru min ʿAliyy
dialogue.en: Muhammad is older than Ali.
dialogue.ur: Muhammad Ali se bada hai.

dialogue.ar: العِلْمُ أَنْفَعُ مِنَ المال.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿilmu anfaʿu mina l-māl
dialogue.en: Knowledge is more beneficial than wealth.
dialogue.ur: Ilm maal se zyada nafa bakhsh hai.

dialogue.ar: عُثْمانُ أَصْغَرُ مِنْ عَدْنان.
dialogue.tr: ʿUthmānu aṣgharu min ʿAdnān
dialogue.en: Uthman is younger than Adnan.
dialogue.ur: Usman Adnan se chhota hai.

dialogue.ar: الطّالِبُ الأَكْبَرُ جَديدٌ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭālibu l-akbaru jadīd
dialogue.en: The oldest student is new.
dialogue.ur: Sab se bada talib-e-ilm naya hai.

dialogue.ar: الطّالِبَةُ الكُبْرى جَديدَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭālibatu l-kubrā jadīda
dialogue.en: The oldest (girl) student is new.
dialogue.ur: Sab se badi talibah nayi hai.

dialogue.ar: عَلِيٌّ أَفْصَحُ مُتَحَدِّثٍ.
dialogue.tr: ʿAliyyun afṣaḥu mutaḥaddith
dialogue.en: Ali is the most eloquent speaker.
dialogue.ur: Ali sab se fasih bolne wala hai.

dialogue.ar: العِلْمُ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ المالِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿilmu afḍalu mina l-māl
dialogue.en: Knowledge is better than wealth.
dialogue.ur: Ilm maal se behtar hai.

q.ur: "Bada" (muqabla) ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ تَفْضيلٍ بِمَعْنى «أَكْثَرُ كِبَراً»؟

q.en: Which word comes before the thing compared?
q.ur: Jis cheez se muqabla ho us se pehle kaun sa harf aata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يَأْتي قَبْلَ المُفَضَّلِ عَلَيْهِ؟

options: Knowledge is more beneficial than wealth / Ilm maal se zyada nafa bakhsh hai
Wealth is better than knowledge / Maal ilm se behtar hai
Knowledge is small / Ilm chhota hai
Wealth is knowledge / Maal ilm hai

q.en: What is the pattern of the comparative?

intro.en: A scene from a play by Ali Ahmad Bakathir. Abu Bakr, the caliph, is ill. Umar visits him, and Abu Bakr asks whom he should appoint as his successor. The scene shows humility, fear of Allah and sincere advice. Then come exercises on useful expressions such as سَمْعاً وَطاعَةً and حُبّاً وَكَرامَةً.
intro.ur: Ali Ahmad Bakathir ke drama ka ek manzar. Khalifa Abu Bakr bimar hain, Umar unse milne aate hain aur Abu Bakr poochte hain ke unke baad kise khalifa banayein. Is mein aajzi, Allah ka khauf aur khair-khwahi nazar aati hai. Phir mufeed jumlon ki mashq hai jaise سَمْعاً وَطاعَةً aur حُبّاً وَكَرامَةً.
intro.ar: مَشْهَدٌ مِنْ مَسْرَحِيَّةٍ لِعَلي أَحْمَد باكَثير: أَبو بَكْرٍ الخَليفَةُ مَريضٌ، وَيَزورُهُ عُمَرُ فَيَسْأَلُهُ مَنْ يَسْتَخْلِفُ. يُظْهِرُ المَشْهَدُ التَّواضُعَ وَخَشْيَةَ اللهِ وَالنُّصْحَ الصّادِقَ. ثُمَّ تَمارينُ عَلى تَعابيرَ مُفيدَةٍ مِثْلَ سَمْعاً وَطاعَةً وَحُبّاً وَكَرامَةً.

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يا خَليفَةَ رَسولِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalayka yā khalīfata rasūli llāh
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you, O successor of the Messenger of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Assalam o alaikum, aye Rasoolullah ke khalifa.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ. أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يا ابْنَ الخَطّابِ؟ فَقَدِ افْتَقَدْتُكَ مُنْذُ أَمْسِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalayka s-salāmu wa raḥmatu llāh. ayna kunta yā bna l-khaṭṭāb? faqadi ftaqadtuka mundhu ams
dialogue.en: And peace and Allah's mercy be upon you. Where were you, son of al-Khattab? I have missed you since yesterday.
dialogue.ur: Wa alaikum assalam wa rahmatullah. Ibn al-Khattab, aap kahan the? Main ne kal se aap ko yaad kiya.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ اللهَ لا يَسْتَحيي مِنَ الحَقِّ. جاءَتْني تِجارَةٌ مِنَ اليَمَنِ؛ فَشَغَلَتْني عَنْكَ.
dialogue.tr: inna llāha lā yastaḥyī mina l-ḥaqq. jā'atnī tijāratun mina l-yaman; fa-shaghalatnī ʿanka
dialogue.en: Allah is not shy of the truth. A trade caravan came to me from Yemen and it kept me busy.
dialogue.ur: Allah haq baat se sharmata nahi. Mere paas Yemen se tijarat aayi thi, us ne mujhe masroof rakha.

dialogue.ar: فَهَلِ انْتَهَيْتَ مِنْها اليَوْم؟
dialogue.tr: fa-hali ntahayta minhā l-yawm?
dialogue.en: Have you finished with it today?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap aaj us se faarigh ho gaye?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ بِعْتُها وَرَبِحْتُ. كَيْفَ أَنْتَ اليَوْمَ يا أَبا بَكْر؟
dialogue.tr: naʿam biʿtuhā wa rabiḥt. kayfa anta l-yawma yā Abā Bakr?
dialogue.en: Yes, I sold it and made a profit. How are you today, Abu Bakr?
dialogue.ur: Jee haan, bech di aur nafa hua. Aaj aap kaise hain, Abu Bakr?

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ للهِ، أَجِدُني بارِئاً يا ابْنَ الخَطّابِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh, ajidunī bāri'an yā bna l-khaṭṭāb
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah, I find myself recovered, son of al-Khattab.
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah, main apne aap ko sehatyaab paata hoon.

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ للهِ.. قَدْ ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّها وَعْكَةٌ خَفيفَةٌ وَتَزولُ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh.. qad ẓanantu annahā waʿkatun khafīfatun wa tazūl
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah. I thought it was a light illness that would pass.
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah. Main samajhta tha ke halki si bimari hai jo door ho jayegi.

dialogue.ar: أَنا في حاجَةٍ إِلَيْكَ في كُلِّ حين. فَهَلْ لَكَ أَنْ تُذاكِرَني فيها يا عُمَر؟
dialogue.tr: anā fī ḥājatin ilayka fī kulli ḥīn. fa-hal laka an tudhākiranī fīhā yā ʿUmar?
dialogue.en: I need you at all times. Will you discuss it with me, Umar?
dialogue.ur: Mujhe har waqt aap ki zaroorat hai. Kya aap mujh se is par mashwara karenge, Umar?

dialogue.ar: حُبّاً وَكَرامَةً يا أَبا بَكْر.
dialogue.tr: ḥubban wa karāmatan yā Abā Bakr
dialogue.en: With love and honour, Abu Bakr.
dialogue.ur: Khushi se aur izzat ke saath, Abu Bakr.

dialogue.ar: ما رَأْيُكَ اليَوْمَ في ذلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: mā ra'yuka l-yawma fī dhālik?
dialogue.en: What is your opinion today about that?
dialogue.ur: Aaj is baare mein aap ki kya raaye hai?

dialogue.ar: إِنَّما أَسْلَموا للهِ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ، يُوَفّيهِمْ ذلِكَ يَوْمَ القِيامَةِ، وَإِنَّما هذِهِ الدُّنْيا بَلاغٌ.
dialogue.tr: innamā aslamū lillāhi wa lahum ajruhum, yuwaffīhim dhālika yawma l-qiyāma, wa innamā hādhihi d-dunyā balāgh
dialogue.en: They submitted to Allah and their reward is with Him; He will give it in full on the Day of Resurrection. This world is only a means to get by.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne Allah ke liye Islam qubool kiya aur unka ajr Allah ke paas hai, woh qiyamat ke din poora dega. Yeh dunya to bas guzara hai.

dialogue.ar: لِمَنْ أَسْتَخْلِفُ؟
dialogue.tr: li-man astakhlif?
dialogue.en: Whom shall I appoint as successor?
dialogue.ur: Main kise apna jaanasheen banaun?

dialogue.ar: اسْتَخْلِفْ أَبا عُبَيْدَةَ؛ فَهُوَ أَمينُ هذِهِ الأُمَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: istakhlif Abā ʿUbayda; fa-huwa amīnu hādhihi l-umma
dialogue.en: Appoint Abu Ubayda, for he is the trustworthy one of this nation.
dialogue.ur: Abu Ubaida ko jaanasheen banayein, woh is ummat ke ameen hain.

dialogue.ar: قَدْ فَكَّرْتُ فيهِ يا ابْنَ الخَطّابِ، وَلكِنّي لَمْ أَجِدْ فيهِ القُوَّةَ الَّتي عِنْدَكَ. إِنَّهُ أَمينٌ، وَلكِنّي أُريدُ القَوِيَّ الأَمينَ.
dialogue.tr: qad fakkartu fīhi yā bna l-khaṭṭāb, wa lākinnī lam ajid fīhi l-quwwata llatī ʿindak. innahu amīn, wa lākinnī urīdu l-qawiyya l-amīn
dialogue.en: I thought about him, but did not find in him the strength you have. He is trustworthy, but I want the strong and trustworthy one.
dialogue.ur: Main ne us par socha, lekin us mein woh quwwat nahi payi jo aap mein hai. Woh ameen hain, magar main taqatwar aur ameen chahta hoon.

dialogue.ar: يا خَليفَةَ رَسولِ اللهِ، كَيْفَ تَسْتَخْلِفُني، وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنّي أُخالِفُكَ في تَقْسيمِ الفَيْءِ؟
dialogue.tr: yā khalīfata rasūli llāh, kayfa tastakhlifunī, wa anta taʿlamu annī ukhālifuka fī taqsīmi l-fay'?
dialogue.en: O successor of the Messenger of Allah, how can you appoint me when you know I differ from you on dividing the spoils?
dialogue.ur: Aye khalifa, aap mujhe kaise jaanasheen banate hain jabke aap jante hain ke main maal-e-fay ki taqseem mein aap se ikhtilaf rakhta hoon?

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ هذا لَيَدْفَعُني إِلى اسْتِخْلافِكَ أَكْثَرَ مِمّا يَثْنيني عَنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: inna hādhā la-yadfaʿunī ilā istikhlāfika akthara mimmā yathnīnī ʿanh
dialogue.en: This pushes me towards choosing you more than it holds me back from it.
dialogue.ur: Yeh baat mujhe aap ko jaanasheen banane ki taraf zyada dhakelti hai, us se rokti kam hai.

dialogue.ar: يا أَبا بَكْر، أَرْجوكَ أَنْ تَرْحَمَني مِنَ الحِسابِ العَسيرِ يَوْمَ القِيامَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yā Abā Bakr, arjūka an tarḥamanī mina l-ḥisābi l-ʿasīri yawma l-qiyāma
dialogue.en: Abu Bakr, I ask you to spare me from the hard reckoning on the Day of Resurrection.
dialogue.ur: Abu Bakr, main aap se guzarish karta hoon ke mujhe qiyamat ke din ke sakht hisaab se bacha lein.

dialogue.ar: في المُسْلِمينَ مَنْ هُوَ أَفْضَلُ مِنّي يا أَبا بَكْر.
dialogue.tr: fī l-muslimīna man huwa afḍalu minnī yā Abā Bakr
dialogue.en: Among the Muslims there is one better than me, Abu Bakr.
dialogue.ur: Musalmanon mein mujh se behtar log maujood hain, Abu Bakr.

dialogue.ar: سَأَفْعَلُ يا أَبا حَفْصٍ. لَقَدْ كُفيتُ العَقَبَةَ الكُبْرى، فَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ بَعْدَها هَيِّنٌ سَهْلٌ بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: sa-afʿalu yā Abā Ḥafṣ. laqad kufītu l-ʿaqabata l-kubrā, fa-kullu shay'in baʿdahā hayyinun sahlun bi-idhnillāh
dialogue.en: I will do so, Abu Hafs. The greatest obstacle has been lifted, so everything after it is easy, by Allah's leave.
dialogue.ur: Main yeh karunga, Abu Hafs. Sab se bari rukawat door ho gayi, ab baqi sab kuch Allah ke hukm se aasaan hai.

vocab.ur: afsos hai tujh par (narmi se tambeeh)

q.en: Whom did Umar suggest as successor?
q.ur: Umar ne jaanasheen ke liye kis ka naam liya?

q.en: What did Abu Bakr want in a leader?
q.ur: Abu Bakr leader mein kya chahte the?
q.ar: ماذا أَرادَ أَبو بَكْرٍ في القائِدِ؟

options: The strong and trustworthy / Taqatwar aur ameen
With love and honour / Khushi aur izzat ke saath
I refuse / Main inkar karta hoon
I do not know / Mujhe nahi pata

q.ur: Umar ek din pehle kyun nahi aaye?

He was ill / Woh bimar the
He travelled to Makkah / Woh Makkah gaye
He was sleeping / Woh so rahe the

options: We hear and obey / Hum ne suna aur maana
We ask and answer / Poochna aur jawab dena
We sit and wait / Baithna aur intezar
We read and write / Parhna aur likhna
